newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline ends sharply higher, bulls in control.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline ends sharply higher, bulls in control.

text.p: NWE gasoline ended sharply higher on Thursday and the bulls seemed well in control with the arbitrage to the U.S. open, crude and gasoline futures holding their gains, and demand buoyant.
"It still looks steady...and NYMEX is still steady," said one broker.
Premium unleaded barges ended $8 higher at $230/$232, with the highest trade heard at $231.
Regular unleaded continued to narrow its discount to premium, to $9 from $14 earlier this week, with the last trade heard done at $222.50 fob ARA, traders said.
Cargo action was thinner but traders said with the arbitrage still looking open, the chance for supplies heading across the Atlantic underpinned NWE.
Premium unleaded cargoes were heard offered at $227 fob after ending yesterday at $218/$220. Cif prices were quoted $10 higher.
